      • group

        public QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition group​(Function<QueryConditionDsl.QueryConditionBuilder,​QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition> group)
        Groups a number of conditions. Alternative syntax to startGroup() and QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition.endGroup() that automatically has the right number start / closes and can provide for the right indention of the IDE. For example: 
                 condition = q.conditionBuilder().isNotNull(PROP_CREATED).and().group((b) -> b.
             upper().property(PROP_TITLE).eq().val("3 THIRD TITLE").or().contains(PROP_TITLE, "THIRD")
         );
        See Also:
        startGroup(), QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition.endGroup()

      • contains

        public QueryConditionDsl.QueryCondition contains​(String fulltextSearchExpression)
        The selected node contains a property with the search expression. You might want to Query.orderBy(String) JcrConstants.JCR_SCORE Query.descending().
        Parameters:
        fulltextSearchExpression - The fulltext search expression. A term not preceded with “-” (minus sign) is satisfied only if the value contains that term. A term preceded with “-” (minus sign) is satisfied only if the value does not contain that term. A phrase can be formed by enclosing several words in double quotes. Terms separated by whitespace are implicitly “ANDed”. Terms separated by “OR” are “ORed”. “AND” has higher precedence than “OR”. Within a term, each “"” (double quote), “-” (minus sign), and “\” (backslash) must be escaped by a preceding “\”.
